item.title: About
item.description: yexca/jɛkɑ/ I build local-first tools, agent workflows, and knowledge systems. A Master's student exploring how AI, agents, and local software can become dependable personal systems. Most of my work starts with a small, recurring friction: preparing data, running models locally, organizing media, or keeping notes usable across four languages. This blog is where I write those down, along with what I'm thinking about life. GitHub Homepage Email RSS Links Posts294 Categories12 …
